commits.messageBody:
Implement rounding and exception masks through MXCSR on x64 while preserving sticky flags and existing DAZ/FTZ state. Report precision as fixed by the float/double operation and make setPrecision unavailable there; only x86 collision code requests selectable x87 precision.

The Win32 x87 path, including its existing old-state precision setter behavior, remains unchanged. Changing that behavior later requires reassessing the DPVS C2 numerical reference.

Matching client production TUs pass native v120 Debug and Release probes: Win32 candidate and stock 46/46 each, x64 67/67 each. A no-op control fails 21 checks; unavailable x64 precision calls fail compilation. These are control-state and sampled rounding tests, not exception-trap, physics or native Direct3D acceptance.

(cherry picked from commit cc361630e09eea6a5ae031fe86907930c9ea39dd)
